name: sockbowl-docker-stomp-probe
description: Runtime-only deps for scripts/stomp-probe.mjs (WP-D3, plan m2-auth.md section 3). Not published; scripts/smoke-auth.sh runs `npm install` here before invoking the probe. Kept as a real package.json + package-lock.json (not npx -p, which does not work for ESM import resolution) so the install is reproducible and offline-cacheable.
